content.user_title: Choose the Right Design and Animation Skill
content.value_statement: Choosing among specialized interface skills can delay the next step. Ask Emil recommends one skill or a short sequence for your situation.
actual_capabilities: Recommend one skill or a short sequence, explain the choice, and identify the next skill.
Direct the assistant to read a candidate skill's instructions before recommending it.
Distinguish web animations, coordinated motion, gestures, and React Native or Expo work.
Route existing interface concerns toward motion audits, animation opportunities, or motion removal.
Map requests for prototyping, library selection, interface stress testing, and mobile web fixes to specialized skills.
Identify reference skills for design principles and animation terminology, plus a standalone Swift skill.
limitations: This skill provides routing guidance rather than implementing designs, animations, or tests itself.
Referenced skills must be available separately so the assistant can read their instructions.
Routing descriptions do not verify the behavior or security of referenced skills.
Recommendations focus on the listed design, animation, mobile, and Swift workflows.

use_cases.title: Select a Motion Workflow
use_cases.description: Find the appropriate skill for an individual animation, coordinated entrance, or touch-driven interaction.

use_cases.title: Choose a Design Exploration Path
use_cases.description: Identify a prototyping workflow when a visual direction needs comparison before implementation.

use_cases.title: Plan Existing Interface Improvements
use_cases.description: Separate motion quality, missing motion, and excessive motion concerns before choosing an upkeep workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Starting Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Which skill should I use to animate a button on the web? Explain the choice and name the next skill.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: route one clear interface task.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Design Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: I cannot choose a layout for our settings screen. Recommend a skill for comparing alternatives and a next step after selection.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: choose a workflow before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify an Upkeep Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Our existing app feels slow and over-animated. Help distinguish motion removal from motion quality review, then recommend one starting skill.

prompt_templates.title: Sequence a Complex Interaction
prompt_templates.prompt: We need a web drawer with drag-to-dismiss and coordinated sibling motion. Read available candidate instructions, recommend a short sequence, and identify follow-up validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: route a task spanning several specialties.

output_examples.input: Which skill fits several list items entering one after another?
output_examples.output: Start with /choreograph because the elements need coordinated timing. Next, use /review-animations to review the resulting motion.

output_examples.input: Our app has too much decorative motion. Where should we start?
output_examples.output: Start with /remove-animations because your goal is to subtract unnecessary motion. Next, use /review-animations to assess what remains.

output_examples.input: We need several visual directions before choosing a design.
output_examples.output: Start with /prototype to compare different versions. Next, use /pick-ui-library if the chosen design needs a component dependency.

best_practices: Describe the platform, interaction, and main problem before requesting a recommendation.
Make candidate skill instructions available so recommendations can be checked against their actual scope.
Request one starting skill, a short reason, and the next step.
anti_patterns: Expecting the router to implement changes instead of recommending a specialized skill.
Treating orientation summaries as verified descriptions when candidate instructions are unavailable.
Requesting the entire skill catalog instead of a focused recommendation.

faq.question: What does Ask Emil return?
faq.answer: It recommends one skill or a short sequence, explains why, and names the next skill.

faq.question: Does it build or modify my interface?
faq.answer: No. It routes your request to specialized skills that may perform implementation, review, or planning.

faq.question: Do I need the referenced skills?
faq.answer: Yes. Their instructions must be available for the assistant to verify suitability before recommending them.

faq.question: Can it help with React Native or Expo?
faq.answer: Yes. Its routing map includes /animate-expo for React Native or Expo animation work.

faq.question: How does it handle unclear motion problems?
faq.answer: It asks whether motion is poor, missing, or excessive, then routes toward the matching upkeep workflow.

faq.question: Does this audit cover every recommended skill?
faq.answer: No. Only the router's SKILL.md was reviewed. Referenced skills require separate review.
